mechanism: Fosfomycin is renally cleared and may accumulate in renal impairment; sacubitril's active metabolite (LBQ657) is also renally eliminated, increasing potential for dual renal burden and toxicity in patients with compromised renal function.
action: Monitor renal function closely; ensure adequate hydration and consider dose adjustments if eGFR <30 mL/min; fosfomycin is generally safe in mild-moderate renal impairment but combined use requires vigilance.
